review.description: Against current main 9a2ae20 this flow retains its existing behavior; retry integration and changed operational CI inputs require renewed review of its consuming source/assertions. Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Relative to fc80, PR3 adds durable encrypted exact replies, bounded conversational attention, same-run owner/ack settlement and source lifecycle while preserving inherited positive-question classification, original blocking status, shared budget, selective legacy recheck and one originating async answer route. S4/graph now explicitly states confirmed-only continuation and diagnostic exhaustion, not unconditional fallback. Rebase addition: accepted pre-agent reviews remain deferred with a retained reason and deadline when managed GitHub source or active-principal verification reaches capacity. Due polling/restart reuses the same run, original authority and automatic claim; live head, current author/principal, request episode, repository policy and cancellation are checked before provider startup. Ordinary provider/publication failures remain outside retry recovery.
review.implementation: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Target final/sibling guards now live in shared putAttention so PR3 native attention+waiting-run transaction receives atomic supersession/resolution events too. Vault.SetTx reply and originating answer claim remain transactional. Strict clarificationResult is separate from owner-answer reconciliation evidence even through shared helper transport. ConversationVersion conservatively invalidates same-run opaque completion chunks without importing them as bounded evidence. OwnerRevision check after settlement prevents stale queued classification. Provider-confirmed completed source restores last-completed identity and the full redacted same-turn journal, including framed chunks, before existing positive question detection. Progress excerpts and bounded owner-answer evidence are not substituted; absence/invalid sources never confirm attention. Rebase comparison against9c549ce retains these owning source paths; conflict changes concern the shared transport, reporting shell and reconciliation context rather than changing this contract. Inspected launch_retry.go deferLaunch, recoverDeferredLaunch, RetryDeferredLaunches and validateLaunchPolicy; runs.go Recover/startRun/launch/Interrupt preserve lockRun/session lifetime and ownerRevision safeguards. activeReviewPrincipal wraps typed rate-limit errors with %w; validateLaunchPolicy retains freshly checked principal evidence instead of overwriting it with synchronized identity. SourceSnapshot.Head remains distinct from checkout Base. Retry authority is durably cleared before uncertain provider creation. These reuse existing run/session owners and add no live provider execution.
review.tests: Retained prior reviewed evidence for unchanged branch inputs: Inspected every actual body of 38 inherited tests plus the current newer-owner and actual accepted-checkpoint controls, recorded individually in classification-test-review.json. Failures/checking/unconfirmed/malformed never add attention; setup/form/clarification share durable 2; native/async delivery and attempts survive restart; duplicate routes retire atomically with history; sibling answers accept exactly one and uncertain claims stay final. Combined native transaction retains matching supersession ordering; exact encrypted replies reopen from separate disk/Vault and reject duplicate overwrite/rollback. Chunked correction preserves pending Params under unchanged status/turn. No real-helper/host gap is closed. New real onMessage final-message crash window produces exactly one confirmed Messages route from a large Unicode question; ordinary text actually creates a resolved/no-input episode, repeated Recover does not duplicate or replay ordinary work. Causal takeover joins before shutdown. Current classification40-test lineage records38 unchanged prior bodies plus two changed/new bodies actually inspected. Read actual TestDeferredReviewRevalidatesActivePrincipal: deleting saved identity still permits one eligible launch, changed self principal fails before workspace/provider, and the request count proves fresh source plus principal reads without recreating synchronized identity. TestDeferredReviewRetainsRetryWhenActivePrincipalBudgetIsDenied checks the retained deadline against UsageStatus.NextRequest, one claim/no agent, restart and exactly one later launch. Existing deadline, concurrent retry, request-episode, cancellation, uncertain-provider and blocked-interrupt assertions remain mapped and the four-package uncached Go race run passed. Fixture results do not close installed-host/provider acceptance gaps.
